investigations: Native automation briefly timed out while the search result was being observed. The same live snapshot handle later completed; runner logs and the visible result both confirmed the expected search output. No shortcut restart was needed.

An old negative test rejecting string includes failed because this feature is now supported. Its unsupported-string-method case now uses indexOf; positive includes coverage is provided by the new tests.
limitations: Search currently accepts one text argument; optional position/end-position is not supported.
String length/indexOf/slice/substring/split/replace remain unsupported; explicit action wrappers cover some of these operations.
No implicit argument coercion, RegExp needles, locale-specific casing methods or argument spreads.
Unicode casing uses native OS tables; equivalence across all Unicode versions and locales is not established.
Literal strings still obey plist representability constraints.
Physical devices and other OS versions remain unverified; full Shortcuts/TypeScript coverage is incomplete.
